Title: Nitin's Day

Cast

1. Nitin - 30 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Sonali - 60 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall

Scene 1: The living room - Night

[Nitin stands in the living room. Sonali stands near him.]

Nitin: "The night is so quiet."

[Nitin lights the oil lamp in the dark room.]

Nitin: "Careful!"

[Nitin blows out the lamp and goes to sleep.]

Sonali (gently): "Good job, Nitin!"

Scene 2: The office - Day

Sonali: "So, here we are!"

[Nitin sits down at his desk and starts typing.]

Nitin: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Nitin answers the phone at his desk.]

Nitin: "Yes, of course."

[Nitin stretches after hours at the computer.]

Nitin (happily): "What happened?"

[Nitin presents the chart and points at the screen.]

Nitin: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Nitin shakes hands with the new client.]

Nitin: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
